name: Admin uses a separate access page and can open user management
covers: public portal does not expose admin login
description: Verifies the public home offers only Student Login and Teacher Login, while #admin has a dedicated sign-in and control center.
steps: Open the StudyFlow home page and verify only Student Login and Teacher Login are displayed
Navigate directly to the StudyFlow URL with #admin at the end
Enter ADM-001 and the configured administrator password
Verify the Admin Control Center overview is visible
expected: Admin access is available through the separate #admin entry point and the registered account directory is visible after login.

name: Student signup generates a StudyFlow ID
description: Verifies student signup generates an ID without allowing admin self-registration.
steps: Enter name and matching password twice
expected: A new STU-### ID is displayed and admin signup is not offered.

name: Teacher signup generates a StudyFlow ID
description: Verifies teacher signup generates a teacher ID.
steps: Enter name and matching password twice
expected: A new TCH-### ID is displayed.

name: New student can log in with generated ID
description: Verifies the generated student ID and password work at login.
steps: Log in using the ID and chosen password

name: Mismatched signup passwords are rejected
description: Verifies mismatched passwords do not create an account.
expected: A validation message appears and no account is created.

name: Teacher enters marks and admin publishes student results
description: Verifies marks are stored as a draft and only become visible to students after admin publication.
steps: Select a student and course, enter CA and exam marks, semester, year and assessment name
Log in as administrator and publish the draft
Log in as the selected student and open My Results
expected: The result total and grade are calculated, remains a draft until published, and is visible in My Results only after publication.

name: Slow or offline connections show useful loading and retry feedback
description: Verifies that waiting for the API is visible and users can recover from network problems instead of seeing a blank dashboard.
steps: Sign in with a valid demo account while the dashboard API is delayed
Verify the StudyFlow loading screen and skeleton cards are visible
Allow the dashboard request to exceed the timeout
Verify a clear timeout message and Retry control are displayed
Verify the offline banner appears and sign-in actions are disabled
expected: StudyFlow shows progress while waiting, communicates timeout/offline problems clearly, and offers a retry after connectivity returns.
